title: TAMIU Hosts International Education Week With 15+ Events Nov. 16–20
excerpt: Texas A&M International University is hosting International Education Week Nov. 16–20, with more than 15 international-themed events including a cultural festival, study-abroad sessions and a movie night, organized by the Office of International Experiences.
content:
Texas A&M International University is celebrating International Education Week with a lineup of more than 15 international-themed events running Monday, Nov. 16 through Friday, Nov. 20, 2026, according to the university. The events are organized by the Office of International Experiences and are open to currently enrolled TAMIU students.

The week opened Monday with a Cultural Festival in the Senator Judith Zaffirini Student Success Center, room 101, at noon, honoring the traditions and cuisine of England, France, Germany, Ghana, Japan, South Korea, Spain and Taiwan, with complimentary bites from each country and information on study abroad programs, according to TAMIU. A Discover Exchange Opportunities information session followed at 3 p.m. in the Student Center, room 230.

Tuesday brings a Japan study abroad session at 9:30 a.m., an International Education Week celebration from 11 a.m. to 1 p.m. where University President Dr. Christopher Maynard will formally inaugurate the week, a Taiwan study abroad session at 4:30 p.m., and an International Movie Night screening of Luca at 6:30 p.m. at the Residential Learning Community, according to TAMIU. The Tuesday celebration is by invitation only.

Wednesday offers a Study Abroad Pathway event from 9:30 to 11:30 a.m. on the Student Center Walkway, study abroad sessions for England at 12:30 p.m. and France at 3:30 p.m., and an International Cooking Class at 6 p.m. at University Village, where students can learn to prepare matcha, according to TAMIU. Spots for the cooking class are limited and registration is required.

Thursday features a photo exhibit contest from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. in the Student Success Center lobby, plus study abroad sessions for South Korea at 11 a.m., Spain at 3 p.m., and Belgium, Germany and Italy at 4:30 p.m., according to TAMIU. Friday closes the week with a South Korea criminal justice study abroad session at 10 a.m., a Ghana session at noon, and a Summer Programs Application Party from 9 a.m. to 2 p.m. in the Student Success Center, room 223.

Several summer, faculty-led study abroad programs are now open, and the deadline for completed summer applications is Feb. 1, 2027, according to TAMIU. Student Luis Martínez, who studied abroad in Japan and traveled through Tokyo, said the experience changed how he sees things and inspired him to research public spaces and how communities shape them, according to the university.

Source: Texas A&M International University, Nov. 16, 2026.
